title: Chapter 86
text: Though her extraordinary signet allows her to extend the wards around herself and her dragon, Cadet Sorrengail lacks the consistent ability to produce her own wards without extreme emotional distress. I’m sorry to report I doubt this ability will develop in time. I had such hopes for her. —M EMORANDUM FROM P ROFESSOR C ARR TO G ENERAL S ORRENGAIL
